explanation: I searched Mathlib for every use of toRightFun, toLeftFun, rightQuotientEquiv and leftQuotientEquiv. Mathlib/GroupTheory/Complement.lean has only mul_inv_toRightFun_mem, toRightFun_mul_inv_mem, mk''_rightQuotientEquiv and rightQuotientEquiv_apply. None of these says that toRightFun fixes elements of the transversal. rightQuotientEquiv_apply needs a function f out of the right-coset quotient and a complement built from its range, so it doesn't apply to a general complement hR and r ∈ R without an extra argument. The other files that use these names (Schreier, Transfer, CosetCover, DiscontinuousSubgroup) only use the existing lemmas.
